summary: San Francisco Bay Area, Unix user, FreeBSD professional since 1998, cloud storage provider founder (rsync.net), strong advocate for privacy and security in technology, interest in modular mobile phones, supporter of open-source software, engaged in discussions about government surveillance and encryption, enjoys hiking and outdoor activities, has a background in computer networking and system administration, critical of corporate tech practices, family-oriented with a tradition of outdoor activities, interested in health and fitness, particularly through walking and resistance training.
